description: Middleware admin guard + admin server actions. This is the pure infrastructure layer with no UI. FEAT-002 depends on this being done first because the admin pages import from src/app/actions/admin.ts.
steps: 1. Extend src/lib/supabase/middleware.ts: after the existing /dashboard guard, add a block that checks /admin/* routes. If the user is not authenticated, redirect to /auth/login. If authenticated, query `supabase.from('profiles').select('role').eq('id', user.id).single()` and if role !== 'admin', redirect to '/'. Return supabaseResponse at the end. IMPORTANT: the profiles query uses the same supabase client already created in the function — no second client needed.

2. Create src/app/actions/admin.ts with 'use server' directive. Implement these six exported async functions — each must first call createClient(), get the user, fetch their profile, and return { error: 'No autorizado' } if role !== 'admin':
   a) getAdminStats(): queries businesses table for count(*), count where is_active=true, count where is_verified=true; queries profiles table for count(*); queries businesses where is_verified=false for pendingVerification count; queries businesses grouped by category_id joined with categories(name) for businessesPerCategory array. Return typed object.
   b) getAllBusinesses(): select('*, categories(name, icon, color), profiles!businesses_owner_id_fkey(full_name)') from businesses, no is_active filter, order by created_at desc. Note: the foreign key join syntax for owner profile may not work if RLS blocks it — fall back to select('*, categories(name, icon, color)') and include owner_id in the result; the UI will truncate owner_id.
   c) getAllUsers(): select('*, businesses(count)') from profiles order by created_at desc. Return typed array.
   d) toggleBusinessActive(id: string): update businesses set is_active = NOT is_active where id=id; call revalidatePath('/admin/negocios').
   e) toggleBusinessVerified(id: string): update businesses set is_verified = NOT is_verified where id=id; call revalidatePath('/admin/negocios').
   f) changeUserRole(userId: string, newRole: 'user' | 'owner'): update profiles set role=newRole where id=userId; call revalidatePath('/admin/usuarios').

3. Add AdminStats interface to src/types/index.ts:
   export interface AdminStats {
     totalBusinesses: number
     activeBusinesses: number
     verifiedBusinesses: number
     totalUsers: number
     pendingVerification: number
     businessesPerCategory: { category: string; count: number }[]
   }
   Also add BusinessWithOwner type alias:
   export type BusinessWithOwner = Business & { profiles?: { full_name: string | null } | null }
acceptance_criteria: Visiting /admin while unauthenticated redirects to /auth/login (enforced by middleware).
Visiting /admin while authenticated as a non-admin user redirects to / (enforced by middleware).
src/app/actions/admin.ts compiles without TypeScript errors under strict mode.
All six admin server actions return { error: 'No autorizado' } when called by a non-admin user.
`npm run build` passes with no errors after this FEAT.
verification: Run `npm run build` in c:\Users\Alanis\Documents\apps ideas\encuentrameTB and confirm it exits with code 0 and no TypeScript/ESLint errors.
findings: 1) Supabase count query shape: supabase.from('categories').select('*, businesses(count)') returns rows where businesses is [{count: N}] — must cast via `row.businesses as unknown as { count: number }[]` and read [0].count. 2) There is no FK from businesses.owner_id to profiles.id so owner join was skipped in getAllBusinesses(); owner_id is included as-is in BusinessWithOwner. 3) toggleBusinessActive/Verified require a separate SELECT to read the current boolean before flipping it, since Supabase JS client does not support UPDATE SET col = NOT col directly. 4) getAdminStats uses getCategoriesWithCount-style query (categories + businesses(count)) for businessesPerCategory. 5) Build passes with exit code 0 and no TypeScript/ESLint errors.
